Microstate closest to the one predicted at pH 7.4, out of 2 enumerated. The selection is reproducible, but the class-based pKa table does not resolve the population of this class. Under review because of protonated amine with an electron-withdrawing group one or two bonds from the N (CF3 or CHF2 at β, nitrile at α or β): the group lowers the class pKa the table assigns (9.8) by several units; 2,2,2-trifluoroethylamine has pKa ≈5.7 and 3-aminopropionitrile ≈7.8, so the charge at pH 7.4 is an open decision. Review the species before a free-energy calculation.

0.535 kcal/mol per heavy atom (13 atoms). Hopkins et al. 2004. It depends on size by construction: measured across this project's cohort (17,431 molecules), its correlation with atom count is as strong as that of the raw score, with the opposite sign.
3.221 = |affinity| / HA^0.3. Nissink, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 49 (2009) 1617. The paper does not publish a threshold, so none is used here.

0.675 = LE / LE_scale(HA), where LE_scale = 0.0715 + 7.5328/HA + 25.7079/HA² − 361.4722/HA³ (Reynolds, Tounge, Bembenek, J. Med. Chem. 51 (2008) 2432, Eq. 1–2). LE_scale used: 0.5808 in pKi units. PROXY: the scale was fitted against experimental Ki, not docking scores; the conversion uses 1.37 kcal/mol per log unit. FQ ≈ 1 means proximity to the efficient frontier of the Reynolds set for that size—it is not a probability of binding or pose quality. The scale was capped at HA=15: the Reynolds fit covers 15–50 heavy atoms, and this molecule falls outside that range, so the value is a bound, not an interpolation.

incertidumbres: This receptor has no measured Spearman ρ, and its structural family has no calibrated stacking, so it runs under the shared conservative alpha contract. There is no evidence that the ranking correlates with actual affinity here. Treat the result as a hypothesis to test, not as a measurement.

Meeko-assigned histidine templates: A:178=HIE, A:220=HIE, A:222=HIE, A:228=HIE, A:280=HIE, A:296=HIE, A:370=HIE, A:372=HIE, A:441=HIE, A:598=HIE, A:599=HIE, A:613=HIE. The assignment is template-based and does not validate the experimental microstate or a specific pH.

Desolvated preparation: 23 crystallographic waters were removed from the docking box; 10 had at least 3 contacts within 3.5 Å of the receptor (the best-coordinated water had 6). If any of these waters participates in recognition by this target—such as the catalytic water in HIV-1 protease or the hinge network in some kinases—this run's contacts do not include it.

Ligand efficiency LE=0.53. With 13 heavy atoms, the 0.45 threshold is crossed by any affinity better than -5.9 kcal/mol, so exceeding it does not distinguish good binding from mediocre binding. In this mass range (< 300 Da, Rule of Three), efficiency per atom is high by construction: it can compare molecules of the same size, but cannot serve as a verdict.
The docked species differs from the input: FC(F)(F)CNCc1ccccc1 → FC(F)(F)C[NH2+]Cc1ccccc1. Unevaluated alternatives remain a source of chemical uncertainty.
